product.name: Cococart Online Store
product.description: A platform for local businesses to create and manage online stores to accept orders directly from customers.

product.name: Cococart Point of Sale (POS)
product.description: A mobile and tablet app for managing in-person and online sales, allowing businesses to process orders and payments on iOS and Android devices.

product.name: Cococart Bookings
product.description: A service for local businesses to accept and manage bookings and reservations through their online platform.

product.name: Cococart Marketing Tools
product.description: A set of marketing features including coupon codes, customer segmentation, email promotions, and abandoned cart recovery to support local business sales growth.

identifier.value: Cococart Scan To Order (QR Code Menu Ordering Software)

product.name: Cococart Scan To Order (QR Code Menu Ordering Software)
product.description: A QR code-based ordering system that allows customers to order and pay from their smartphones at physical locations.

product.name: Cococart Loyalty Program Software
product.description: A loyalty program system that rewards customers with points for purchases, redeemable for discounts to encourage repeat business.
